entities.name: Task
entities.description: A single to-do item with title, description, completion status, due date, and group membership.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The main label for the task; minimum required field

fields.name: description
fields.description: Optional longer description; displayed as excerpt on Task List

fields.name: done
fields.description: Whether the task is completed; defaults to false

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: The deadline date; null means no deadline

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: FK to the group this task belongs to; null means ungrouped

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Auto-set on insert; Lucid ORM default

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Auto-set on update; Lucid ORM default

fields.name: deleted_at
fields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null means not deleted

relationships.description: Many tasks belong to one group; a task without a group belongs to none

constraints: A task belongs to only one group at a time

entities.name: Group
entities.description: A named container that organizes multiple tasks.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The display name of the group

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Auto-set on insert; Lucid ORM default

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Auto-set on update; Lucid ORM default

fields.name: deleted_at
fields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null means not deleted
